description: Hard constraint bounds applied as pass/fail limits in the Ansys Granta limit-stage and mirrored in src/analysis/decision_matrix.py.

constraints.rationale: Outdoor mapping missions with sustained solar exposure; 'Acceptable' admits coated/stabilised grades.
Limits dimensional drift and stiffness loss in humid field conditions.
Damage tolerance for hard landings and handling impacts (avoid brittle shell).
Closed-shell heating under sun plus ~40 C motor/ESC dissipation.
Mass-critical airframe; excludes steels/Ti by inspection.

load_cases.description: Load-case premises used to derive hard constraints. Nothing here is measured: every value is an assumption of the team (see README Sections 1.4, 3.3 and 5.4) to be replaced by CAD, test or Granta data.
load_cases.safety_factor_source: 14 CFR 25.303 (limit to ultimate load), read through secondary copies; a transport-aircraft rule used as an aeronautical reference value

reference_steel.note: Premise for relative cost per unit volume (course notes: steel reference). The 0.7 USD/kg price is not from an official source.

reference_tube.description: Reference thin-walled tube used to turn IM1 into a mass: a duct-like shell of fixed mean radius and length, flexural rigidity of a 1.0 mm Al 7075-T6 wall. Dimensions are premises read from the Ø36 duct feature and the 30 mm side height of the CAD drawing (the CAD README flags the Ø36 assignment as ambiguous).
